import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long M1 = 998244353L;
    static final long M2 = 1000000007L;

    static long counter = 0;
    static long n_value;
    static long low_sum = 0;
    static long total_answer = 0;
    static long[] pow10 = new long[8];
    static List<Integer>[] num_list = new ArrayList[7];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            num_list[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void build_numbers(int depth, int val) {
        int temp = (int)((counter + M1 - val) % M1);
        num_list[depth].add(temp);
        low_sum = (low_sum + temp) % M2;
        counter++;
        if (depth < 6) {
            for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
                build_numbers(depth + 1, val * 10 + digit);
            }
        }
    }

    static void compute(int depth, long x) {
        if (x > n_value) return;
        if (x * pow10[6] + pow10[6] - 1 <= n_value && x * pow10[7] > n_value) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long delta = (counter + (M1 - pow10[i]) * x) % M1;
                long idx = lowerBound(num_list[i], (int)(M1 - delta));
                total_answer = (total_answer + (delta + M2 - M1) * pow10[i] + M1 * idx) % M2;
            }
            total_answer = (total_answer + low_sum) % M2;
            counter += 1111111;
            return;
        }
        total_answer = (total_answer + (counter + M1 - x % M1) % M1) % M2;
        counter++;
        int startDigit = (depth == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int i = startDigit; i < 10; i++) {
            compute(depth + 1, x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static long lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0;
        int high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        pow10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 7; i++) {
            pow10[i] = pow10[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        build_numbers(0, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(num_list[i]);
        }
        n_value = sc.nextLong();
        counter = 0;
        total_answer = 0;
        compute(0, 0);
        System.out.println(total_answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
